name: CoolerControl
description: CoolerControl is a Linux cooling control and monitoring daemon with a built-in web interface. It can control supported fans and cooling devices exposed through hwmon, liquidctl, NVML and other supported backends.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Persistent CoolerControl daemon configuration, profiles and settings.

paths.name: Hardware Monitoring
paths.description: Host hwmon interface. Read/write access is required for fan control through pwm channels.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: CoolerControl web interface and REST API.

ports.name: gRPC API
ports.description: CoolerControl gRPC API. Normally only needed for integrations or plugins.

variables.name: IPv4 Listen Address
variables.description: IPv4 address used by the CoolerControl daemon inside the container. 0.0.0.0 exposes the web interface on the Docker network.

variables.name: Web UI Port
variables.description: CoolerControl daemon and Web UI port.
